title: Identifier
description: Identifier for CO Person or an Organizational Identity

login.description: Whether this Identifier can be used to login to Registry

meta.description:
Metadata about objects returned when reading (get). Note that most metadata returned by read
calls is not permitted (and will be ignored) when invoking write operations (post|put).
The exception is the sub-element id, which when present is used to indicate the update
of an existing object (such as an EmailAddress) rather than the creation of a new one.

id.description: COmanage Registry identifier for this object

actor_identifier.description: The identifier for the actor who last modified this object

created.description: When this object was originally created

deleted.description: Whether this object has been deleted

modified.description: When this object was last modified

revision.description: The revision number for this object
